en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is neither Zakāt upon the beans nor upon the melons and it’s similar, except whatever gathers with you from the produce, and it remains with you for a year’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Zakat is not due on legumes, melons and similar things except that if anything of grain accumulated with you remains for one year.”’
